request.brief: The Regency Court, Qing China 1910. A child emperor and entrenched court prevent decisive government: penalties to political power, stability, and research. Draw one large empty Qing imperial throne from the front, in dark lacquered wood with aged amber-gold relief and one deep crimson seat cushion. Compact upright proportions, dark shadows behind the arms and strong clear pale brass accents, readable at 60×68. It is an empty throne, not an occupant or a portrait, and the empty seat is the point. Distinct from the jade seal used for the positive Regency Council focus. Simplify the silhouette into broad planes, no European royal crown, no text, no plaque or decorative border, no scenery; transparency outside the furniture only. Match vanilla HOI4 painted national-spirit rendering.

prompt.text:
Create one Hearts of Iron IV idea and national spirit picture: The Regency Court, Qing China 1910. A child emperor and entrenched court prevent decisive government: penalties to political power, stability, and research. Draw one large empty Qing imperial throne from the front, in dark lacquered wood with aged amber-gold relief and one deep crimson seat cushion. Compact upright proportions, dark shadows behind the arms and strong clear pale brass accents, readable at 60×68. It is an empty throne, not an occupant or a portrait, and the empty seat is the point. Distinct from the jade seal used for the positive Regency Council focus. Simplify the silhouette into broad planes, no European royal crown, no text, no plaque or decorative border, no scenery; transparency outside the furniture only. Match vanilla HOI4 painted national-spirit rendering.

Requirements:
- One centred subject, an emblem, a figure, an object or a small scene, readable at 60x68 pixels: a few large, clear shapes with readable contrast and no fine detail that disappears at that size.
- Painterly, slightly aged texture in the style of Hearts of Iron IV interface art.
- Real transparent background: no backdrop, no frame, no border, no plate behind the subject.
- Leave a small empty margin around the subject.

Reference images, in the order attached:
1. style anchor: match its painting style, palette and level of detail
The style anchor images were chosen for this image. Match their form, framing, materials and palette; the vanilla form described under Requirements applies only where they do not show one.

Avoid: text; letters or numbers; watermark or signature; a drawn checkerboard pattern; a frame or border.

Produce exactly one image.
